sentences.source: But where does chocolate come from?
sentences.display: But where does chocolate come from?
sentences.translation: 하지만 초콜릿은 어디에서 올까?

sentences.source: Chocolate is made from the fruit of cacao trees, starting about 100 million years ago.
sentences.display: Chocolate is made from the fruit of cacao trees, starting about 100 million years ago.

meaningSegments.en: from the fruit of cacao trees,

chunks.text: from the fruit of cacao trees,

sentences.source: The Olmecs of Mexico were probably the first to grow the cacao plant.
sentences.display: The Olmecs of Mexico were probably the first to grow the cacao plant.
sentences.translation: 멕시코의 올멕족은 아마도 카카오 식물을 재배한 최초의 사람들이었을 것이다.

sentences.source: It is thought that they used the cacao beans to make drinks, but there is no written history for the Olmecs.
sentences.display: It is thought that they used the cacao beans to make drinks, but there is no written history for the Olmecs.
sentences.translation: 그들이 카카오콩으로 음료를 만들었다고 여겨지지만, 올멕족에 대한 기록된 역사는 없다.

sentences.source: The Olmecs passed their cacao knowledge to the Ancient Maya of Mexico and Central America, who made chocolate into a spicy drink used in ceremonies.
sentences.display: The Olmecs passed their cacao knowledge to the Ancient Maya of Mexico and Central America, who made chocolate into a spicy drink used in ceremonies.
sentences.translation: 올멕족은 자신들의 카카오 지식을 멕시코와 중앙아메리카의 고대 마야인들에게 전했고, 그들은 초콜릿을 의식에 사용되는 매운 음료로 만들었다.

meaningSegments.en: to the Ancient Maya of Mexico and Central America,

sentences.source: Cacao started to become very precious.

sentences.translation: 카카오는 매우 귀중해지기 시작했다.

chunks.text: the Aztecs used cacao for trade

sentences.source: In 1502, Christopher Columbus was the first European explorer to come into contact with cacao beans when he and his crew captured a trade ship.

sentences.source: The Spanish Conquistador, Hernán Cortés, arrived in Central America in 1519.
sentences.display: The Spanish Conquistador, Hernán Cortés, arrived in Central America in 1519.
sentences.translation: 스페인 정복자 에르난 코르테스는 1519년에 중앙아메리카에 도착했다.

sentences.source: There he saw the Aztec Emperor drinking 'Xocalatl,' the earliest known hot chocolate, and Cortés realised the great value that it had.
sentences.display: There he saw the Aztec Emperor drinking 'Xocalatl,' the earliest known hot chocolate, and Cortés realised the great value that it had.
sentences.translation: 그곳에서 그는 아즈텍 황제가 최초의 핫초콜릿으로 알려진 '소칼라틀'을 마시는 것을 보았고, 코르테스는 그것이 지닌 큰 가치를 깨달았다.

sentences.source: Almost ten years later Cortés established a cacao plantation for trading.

meaningSegments.en: along with the chocolate drink recipe.

sentences.source: In 1657, the first chocolate house was opened in London.
